Local OTLP Trace Ingest Reference

HTTP/JSON and gRPC specification for writing OpenTelemetry spans into a local Kestrel ring buffer.

POST /v1/traces

Accepts standard OpenTelemetry ExportTraceServiceRequest payloads encoded as Protocol Buffers (application/x-protobuf) or OTLP/JSON (application/json). Payloads are validated synchronously and appended to the local write-ahead log before returning HTTP 2
